title: Warehouse exception triage
brief: Build a self-contained HTML operations table for dispatch exceptions, with status filtering, sortable age and batch assignment.
context: Records: D31 overdue 48h unassigned; D32 waiting 12h unassigned; D33 overdue 24h Sam; D34 ready 2h unassigned; D35 overdue 72h unassigned; D36 waiting 6h Jo. Core task: compare exception age, select D31 and D35, assign both to Lee. Desktop viewport 1440x900; compact viewport 390x844.
constraints: For compact width, horizontal table scrolling is acceptable if controls remain reachable.
Do not add dashboard metrics or charts.

checks.criterion: Descending age yields D35, D31, D33, D32, D36, D34 when unfiltered.
Selecting D31 and D35 then assigning Lee changes only those records and exposes the selected count before applying.
Selecting overdue leaves D31, D33 and D35; clearing the filter restores all six records.
Age, status and assignee can be compared across all six rows at 1440x900 without opening separate detail cards.
